system.name: Rowan
system.one_liner: an RDMA-based abstraction that combines small writes from many senders into large PM writes to mitigate write amplification

components.name: Senders
components.role: issue SEND requests of varying sizes (32B, 56B, 384B) to the receiver

components.name: RNIC
components.role: receiver-side NIC that lands SEND data into receive buffers and generates completion entries

components.name: SRQ
components.role: shared receive queue holding fixed 64B receive buffers, consumed in address order

components.name: MP SRQ
components.role: multi-packet shared receive queue with large (4MB) receive buffers and a 64B stride, allowing multiple SENDs per buffer

components.name: CQ
components.role: completion queue that receives generated completion entries

components.name: control thread
components.role: posts receive buffers into the (MP) SRQ and polls the CQ

content.key_idea: Using RDMA SEND/RECV with an address-ordered shared receive queue lets a receiver-side RNIC combine small writes from multiple senders into the same PM cacheline region without CPU involvement; a multi-packet SRQ (b) fixes the basic design's (a) inability to receive writes larger than the fixed buffer size.
content.reading_order: left to right within each subfigure: senders at top issue writes into the RNIC, which lands data into the receive-buffer structure below and generates completions on the right; (a) then (b) compare the basic and multi-packet designs.

summary: Rowan is an RDMA-based write abstraction that lets a receiver-side RNIC combine small writes from many senders into the same persistent-memory cachelines, mitigating device-level write amplification (DLWA) without extra round trips or slow atomic verbs. Figure 4 shows how Rowan is realized on off-the-shelf RNICs using RDMA SEND/RECV. Subfigure (a) shows the basic architecture: senders issue 32B, 56B, and 384B writes to the receiver's RNIC, which lands data into fixed 64B receive buffers drawn from a shared receive queue (SRQ) in address order, generating completion entries (CE) into a completion queue (CQ) that a dedicated control thread polls; the 384B write fails because it exceeds the 64B buffer. Subfigure (b) fixes this using a multi-packet SRQ (MP SRQ) with large 4MB receive buffers and a 64B stride, so multiple sends of varying sizes can be appended into the same buffer. The two subfigures are drawn as parallel dashed-bordered receiver boxes with matching internal structure, using color (blue/navy/gray/red) to distinguish the sender writes and to flag the failure case.
summary_zh: 图4展示Rowan如何用现成RNIC实现：(a)基础架构用固定64B接收缓冲区的共享接收队列(SRQ)，384B写入因超出缓冲区大小而失败；(b)采用多包共享接收队列(MP SRQ)搭配64B步长的4MB大缓冲区，可容纳可变大小的写入，从而合并小写入以缓解持久内存写放大。
